sar.narrative: On or about 2016-11-22 20:11:00, financial institution detection systems identified suspicious activity associated with account holder C13487 on card C13487-K1. Transaction 3478561 in the amount of $74.96 was executed via the online channel (C). The transaction exhibited significant anomalies including 1.3x deviation from historical median spending and novel device profile infrastructure (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080). Contact was initiated with the cardholder, who confirmed that the transaction was unauthorized and executed without their consent. The identified activity represents confirmed undocumented with total unauthorized exposure of $74.96. In accordance with federal Bank Secrecy Act and Suspicious Activity Reporting guidelines, the compromised card has been placed under permanent block and scheduled for reissue, and all connected network entities are subject to ongoing monitoring.
